mission: The resonance catches — Ben stops trying to control it. The breakthrough comes when he lets go and listens instead of leading. The three notes find their own relationship — emergent, not commanded.
why_now: The climactic breakthrough — Ben's arc completing through action. The new truth demonstrated: trust, surrender of control, orchestration rather than possession.
conflict: Ben's internal battle: every Skywalker instinct screams to take control, to force the harmony. His need demands the opposite. He lets go.
turning_point: Ben stops leading and starts listening. The three traditions — instead of being forced into alignment — find their own relationship. An emergent harmony, a chord built from notes that shouldn't fit but do. The resonance catches. Warmth after cold.
opening_hook: The discordance is reaching critical. Sera's jaw is set. Kael's hands are trembling. Ben is trying everything he knows and nothing is working. Then he thinks of Desh — the man who leads by making space for other people's competence. And he lets go.
closing_hook: The resonance catches. The warmth is physical — not metaphorical. After the bone-deep cold of de-structuring, after months of the wrongness, the return of structure feels like hearing a note you didn't know you were part of. Relief, not triumph.
emotional_trajectory: Desperate control -> the moment of surrender -> the breakthrough warmth

stakes.personal: Ben's arc culminating — trust and surrender as strength
stakes.interpersonal: Three traditions harmonizing — the thematic argument made physical
stakes.external: The resonance works. The question is whether it's enough.

setting: Veranthos — mid-valley, hands linked, the resonance catching
sensory_details: The three notes finding their relationship — not any single tradition's structure but something emergent; warmth returning through the Force after cold; the lattice reforming not as rigid grid but as living tissue — flexible, dynamic; relief like breathing after nearly drowning
promises_paid: Three different traditions can work in concert (PP13)
The Codex's theoretical framework has a real-world answer (PP14)
Gavran's resonance note matters to the climax (PP10)
notes: THE climactic moment. Use the full lattice resonance sensory vocabulary from the concept seed. The warmth returning after cold is the emotional climax. Ben letting go of control = his arc resolution in action = the thematic argument embodied = the plot resolution. All four are the same moment.
